The '''Descri Wris''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Space]]. It connected to the loop of [[Nache Bhelfia]] via [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and [[Athiss/Legends|Athiss]].
